name: Caller Context Policy Enforcement
description: Adds a surface policy that allows only JWT callers in the PowerUser group.
details: Installs a surface-level OPA policy evaluated on inbound requests. The starter rule requires JWT source authentication and PowerUser group membership; edit the Rego to add group, claim, identity, or time-based rules as needed. Surface policies run after gateway-level policy and can be stacked.
author: system

config.name: caller_context
config.rego:
package surface.policy

default allow := false

allow if {
    input.source_auth.method == "jwt_bearer"
    input.source_auth.claims.groups[_] == "PowerUser"
}

deny_reason := "Caller must belong to the PowerUser group" if not allow
